title: Rename Coord to Coordinate
description: Rename the domain type `Coord` to `Coordinate` across all compose language implementations (py, ts, rs, cs, go, rb, graphql, jsonschema, openapi, xmi, liveblocks, assets, AGENTS.md). The AGENTS.md spec already standardizes on `Coordinate` (section "Coordinate" at line 2312, class `Coordinate` at line 701), but many source files still use the abbreviation `Coord`. Apply word-boundary aware substitution covering: Coord->Coordinate, Coords->Coordinates, coord->coordinate, coords->coordinates. Preserve already-correct `Coordinate` tokens. Do not touch ticket folders, session logs, cursor plans, or other historical artifacts. Run test suites per implementation to confirm.
summary: (Accidentally reopened; re-closing with original summary restored.) Renamed `Coord`/`coord` → `Coordinate`/`coordinate` across the compose source tree using a scoped regex rewrite. 27 files, 743 replacements across Python, TypeScript/JS, Rust, Go, C#, GraphQL, JSON schema, OpenAPI, XMI, Liveblocks, Mermaid, and asset fixtures. Cascade updates: renamed `nakagin-capsule-tower.paste.with-coord.design.diff.compose.json` to `...with-coordinate...` with references updated in `compose/go/main_test.go`, `compose/net/Compose.Tests/Tests.cs`, `compose/assets/index.ts`, `compose/assets/compose/copy-paste.cases.compose.json`; Go hash tag strings changed to `Coordinate`/`CoordinateDiff`, deliberately changing the canonical kit hash; `hash.cases.compose.json` expected hash updated to `8b77d0ccf79c61e6454df276c3d29c0c8f40a84e49a3e2e2179f54d1455b99ee`; fixed unrelated `compose/rs/Cargo.toml` path. Verification: Rust 77/77 pass; Go builds with only pre-existing unrelated test failures (confirmed at pre-rename commit 63eec0e86); JS 211/228 pass with pre-existing divergence; .NET does not compile due to pre-existing `Model`→`Representation` over-rewrite. Follow-ups: unify JS/Go kit hash, fix `Model`→`Representation` artifacts, resolve `sqlmodel` package.
